sparql:
PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/> PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/> PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT ?continentLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?paper) AS ?studyCount)
WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C65000 .
  ?contribution orkgp:wikidata:P30 ?continent .
  ?continent rdfs:label ?continentLabel .
}
GROUP BY ?continentLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?studyCount)

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/> PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/> PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT ?paper ?paperLabel ?approachLabel ?taxonLabel
WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C65000 .
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  ?contribution orkgp:HAS_APPROACH ?approach .
  ?approach rdfs:label ?approachLabel .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?approachLabel)), LCASE("observational")))
  ?contribution orkgp:P39141 ?taxon .
  ?taxon rdfs:label ?taxonLabel .
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel ?taxonLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/> PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/> PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT ?paper ?paperLabel ?scaleLabel
WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C65000 .
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  ?contribution orkgp:P115002 ?scale .
  ?scale rdfs:label ?scaleLabel .
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel ?scaleLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/> PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/> PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT ?paper ?paperLabel ?dataSourceLabel
WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C92000 .
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  ?contribution orkgp:P112020 ?dataSource .
  ?dataSource rdfs:label ?dataSourceLabel .
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel ?dataSourceLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/> PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/> PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT ?countryLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?paper) AS ?studyCount)
WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C92000 .
  ?contribution orkgp:wikidata:P17 ?country .
  ?country rdfs:label ?countryLabel .
}
GROUP BY ?countryLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?studyCount) ?countryLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/> PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/> PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?paper ?paperLabel ?windRoseLabel
WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C92000 .
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  ?contribution orkgp:P149068 ?windRose .
  ?windRose rdfs:label ?windRoseLabel .
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?windRoseLabel)) = LCASE("yes"))
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/> PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/> PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT ?disease ?diseaseLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?paper) AS ?studyCount)
WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C123091 .
  ?contribution orkgp:P134011 ?disease .
  ?disease rdfs:label ?diseaseLabel .
}
GROUP BY ?disease ?diseaseLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?studyCount)

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/> PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/> PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT ?paper ?paperLabel ?diseaseLabel ?areaLabel
WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C123091 .
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  ?contribution orkgp:P134011 ?disease .
  ?disease rdfs:label ?diseaseLabel .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?diseaseLabel)), LCASE("obes")))
  ?contribution orkgp:P135009 ?area .
  ?area rdfs:label ?areaLabel .
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel ?areaLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/> PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/> PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT ?paper ?paperLabel ?diseaseLabel ?dietLabel
WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C123091 .
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  ?contribution orkgp:P134011 ?disease .
  ?disease rdfs:label ?diseaseLabel .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?diseaseLabel)), LCASE("type 2 diabet")))
  ?contribution orkgp:P191006 ?diet .
  ?diet rdfs:label ?dietLabel .
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel ?dietLabel
